empty.evidence: Proof step4.2 sums over the strict-lower pattern P_L; if it is empty then ell=I=J=0, so setup has no multiplier division or matching update. Proof step6.1 still counts the actual upper-factor slots and n diagonal divisions. A successful diagonal matrix is included rather than excluded as empty data.

iff-forward.evidence: Definition requires a reduced rational one-step stability function to be defined exactly when its denominator is nonzero; being defined therefore entails that nonzero-denominator domain test. The multistep criterion separately retains a nonzero leading coefficient and simple unit roots.

iff-reverse.evidence: Definition of the reduced rational multiplier also makes a nonzero denominator sufficient for being defined at that z. This domain equivalence alone does not assert |R(z)|<=1; membership in the stability region additionally requires that separate modulus inequality.
